input.summary: Delete the minimum monthly fee floor so we pay only for Hosting and Support Services actually requested.
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the minimum monthly fee floor (currently left blank) so that we pay only for the Hosting Services and Support Services we actually request, consistent with our position against take-or-pay commitments. If a floor is essential, we could accept one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.
